purpose: A pending lower send installs an owning input array before a distinct pending upper throw parks the used-yield leaf. Reference-cache replacement, an independent old-row snapshot, caller identity/getters and explicit close distinguish transient cache counts from the unconsumed input slot.

<?php
class ReviewBufferedPendingOld22 { function __destruct() { echo "A|"; } }
class ReviewBufferedPendingLive22 { function __destruct() { echo "CACHE|"; } }
class ReviewBufferedPendingPayload22 { function __destruct() { echo "B|"; } }
function &reviewBufferedPendingLeaf22() { global $cache; try { echo "C|"; $input = yield 7 => $cache; echo "BAD-BODY|"; } catch (Exception $caught) { echo "BAD-CATCH|"; } finally { echo "F|"; } }
function reviewBufferedPendingLower22() { try { echo "L|"; yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "BAD-LOWER|"; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function reviewBufferedPendingUpper22() { try { echo "M|"; yield from $GLOBALS["lower"]; echo "BAD-UPPER|"; } finally { echo "K|"; } }
function reviewBufferedPendingOuter22() { try { echo "O|"; yield from $GLOBALS["upper"]; echo "BAD-OUTER|"; } finally { echo "Z|"; } }
$cache = [new ReviewBufferedPendingOld22()]; $exception = new Exception("buffered-pending22");
$child = reviewBufferedPendingLeaf22(); $lower = reviewBufferedPendingLower22(); $upper = reviewBufferedPendingUpper22(); $outer = reviewBufferedPendingOuter22();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind();
$row = $lower->send([new ReviewBufferedPendingPayload22()]); echo "S|", $row[0] instanceof ReviewBufferedPendingOld22 ? "OLD|" : "BAD|";
$cache = [new ReviewBufferedPendingLive22()]; echo "W|";
try { $upper->throw($exception); echo "BAD-RETURN|"; }
catch (Exception $caught) { echo "CATCH|", $caught === $exception ? 1 : 0, "|", $caught->getPrevious() === null ? 1 : 0, "|"; }
echo "GET|", $upper->current()[0] instanceof ReviewBufferedPendingLive22 ? 1 : 0, "|", $upper->key(), "|", $upper->valid() ? 1 : 0, "|";
$row[0] = null; unset($row); echo "ROW|";
unset($outer); echo "OUT|"; unset($upper); echo "UP|"; unset($lower); echo "LOW|"; unset($child); echo "CHILD|";
unset($cache, $caught, $exception); echo "E";
